name: lazy-tabs
title: Lazy tabs
description: Tabs whose panels load when first opened, with a skeleton, an error and Retry per panel, and the loaded ones kept.
docs: Give each tab a load: a function that returns a promise of the panel content, run the first time the tab opens, or plain content for a tab that needs no request. A panel shows the skeleton you pass (per tab or for all), then the content, which is kept so coming back is instant. If the promise rejects the panel says Could not load <tab> with a Retry button (an Error message is shown under it), and no other panel is touched. prefetchOnHover starts a tab after the pointer rests on it for a moment, or at once on focus. A loading tab swaps its icon for a spinner in the same box (a tab without an icon pulses its label), so no tab ever moves while another loads, and its panel is aria-busy; a request is never cancelled by leaving the tab. A row wider than its box scrolls sideways behind fade edges with the selected tab kept in view. keepMounted keeps loaded panels mounted (hidden) so their state survives. Panels are drawn from tabs, so there are no TabsContent children.
